unite_adi: REGULAR UPPER SECONDARY-YEAR 10-LEVEL: B1.2 THEME 8: LIFE IN THE UNIVERSE & THE FUTURE

bolumler.ogrenmeKanitlari: PERFORMANCE ASSIGNMENT: Students create a poster which is about life in 2100. They brainstorm about the possibilities in the future such as robots, aliens, space colonies, space travel, etc. Based on these ideas, students produce sentences about their future using the target grammar structures. Also, they add some visuals on their posters. The project could also be designed with the help of web 2.0 tools if students prefer. As a final stage, they present their posters in the classroom and find the common possibilities about the future. The assignment will be evaluated by using a rubric scheme, a rating scale, and/or a marking scheme. Öğrenme-Öğretme Yaşantıları
bolumler.temelKabuller: This theme includes the concept of ''life in the universe & the future with its components such as planets and space; life in the universe; space explorations'' and it is assumed that it could be present in almost all languages, with some exceptions. It is assumed that a student in year 10 of an upper secondary school may know what life in the universe & the future, planets and space; life in the universe; space explorations mean in their own language as it is known that almost all people who start to learn a new language bring their pre- existing knowledge (in their own language) with them and transfer it to their new language learning context. However, they may not know how to say these things in another language if this has not yet been covered in their existing curriculum. Fortunately, this existing knowledge in their own language can help them recognise, understand, and learn them more easily in a foreign language, in this case English. As they are students in year 10 of an upper secondary school, they are expected to know some basic vocabulary about ''life in the universe & the future'' in English from previous themes and/or years such as ''time travel, space explorations, alien invasion, and so on'' and also some structures such as ''What (do you think) will happen in the future? (I think) robots will help people in the future?'' in English from the previous themes and/or years. These grammar items and vocabulary are revised during the ''Revision Programme'' at the beginning of the year and they can be used as a basis for learning the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme, so that the new grammatical elements in the current theme can be learnt easily.
bolumler.onDegerlendirme: It is assumed that these students in an upper secondary school are ready to learn the concept of ''life in the universe & the future with its components such as planets and space; life in the universe; space explorations'' cognitively, affectively, and socially since it is appropriate to their age and language level. Therefore, a contextual poster or a large picture could be provided for the students to remember and practise the items that they are related and previously learnt so that they can discuss about the poster and/ or the picture in pairs and write down what they remember. This session can help them revise all the related vocabulary and grammatical elements that they have already learnt from previous themes or from previous years as a preparatory practice. In this way, their performance can be evaluated in terms of how much they remember and how accurately they use these items to build their competence in the current theme. It can help the teacher decide what to emphasise, revise, and practise in order to facilitate the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme. (Their performance can be evaluated by rubrics, a rating scale, and /or a marking scheme during these practices.).
bolumler.zenginlestirme: Objective: To create a futuristic story about planets and space by using target vocabulary and target grammar. Activity 1: Creative Writing: Life in 2124 The teacher explains the task clearly. Students imagine life in the future, such as living on another planet. The teacher gives examples of sentences with target grammar and target vocabulary (e.g., ''If we find new planets, we will need better rockets''.). Next, students write their stories using target grammar and target vocabulary. Then, they read their stories aloud. The teacher listens and gives feedback on pronunciation and sentence correctness. Students reflect on the activity. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
bolumler.destekleme: Objective: To talk about possible future scenarios in space explorations by using target vocabulary and target grammar. Activity 1: Future Space Possibilities The teacher begins the activity by showing flashcards with key words from the word bank (e.g., robots, explore, live, discover, build) and explaining their meanings with visuals or simple definitions. Students then pair up and receive a worksheet with the target grammar such as ''If humans colonise Mars, _________________________ '', and ''If we build better rockets, ___________________________ ''. They use the word bank to fill in the blanks (e.g., ''If we build better rockets, we will explore new planets''.). In the end, the teacher provides feedback on pronunciation and accuracy. Students reflect on the activity. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
